answer: An copycat thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 23 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The inlet counter is kept in yarrow and ember makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 23 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 4247 identities would post 4596 proofs and burn roughly 12 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
